findings.evidence: Both declarations mention only Mathlib types, and their proofs use entrywise extensionality, simp, and norm_smul without any completely bounded API.
findings.fix: Move and export these results in CStarMatrix.lean, generalizing the matrix indices; alternatively expose the underlying map-zero and map-scalar identities and derive the norm equality from them.
findings.issue: The private helpers map_zero_eq and norm_map_smul (line 204) hide reusable CStarMatrix infrastructure unrelated to complete boundedness.

findings.evidence: Both declarations are unannotated; cbNorm_zero and cbNorm_neg already carry @[simp, grind =]. The proposed rewrites eliminate cbNorm equalities to zero and scalar multiples without looping.
findings.fix: Add @[simp, grind =] to both characteristic lemmas.
findings.issue: cbNorm_eq_zero_iff and cbNorm_smul (line 223) lack normal-form automation annotations, preventing automatic definiteness and scalar normalization.

summary: General matrix infrastructure remains private, and characteristic cb-norm normalization lemmas lack automation annotations.
